author: Zoroishere
quote:
I never played GTA 6 and I don't even have PS5.
But funny thing is I CAN rate 0.

(The main reason why this game has too many negative reviews)

It means all haters that haven't played the game even for 1 second can rate.
And it can be true about some fans too. (rate 10 without playing it).
Tbh, this system is broken. Unfortunately, about gaming community people are NOT mature enough to critic freely. There must be a better system that people can link their accounts to here then be able to rate (and only accounts that has the game should be accepted) or if not like this, then it should shows if those people own the game or not.

The hate is forced through game, people are sensitive and don't wanna have fun. 

 I believe people spreading hate and unfortunately the social media is destroying things. Until 10 years ago or even 2018 while Red Dead Redemption 2 came out, there was not such a thing.

Nowadays if any famous game comes out it will be like this. 


DON'T LISTEN TO THE CRITIC BY PEOPLE, 90% of them can be FAKE.

Enjoy your game
